milestones.outcome: One controller rolls out exact skill selections to explicitly enrolled devices, and each device reports what applied or remains pending.
exit_criteria: Guarded signed Git publication serializes exact frozen desired state and refuses stale or competing proposals.
The public install, update and remove paths preserve independent contributions and report each device through verified receipts, including incomplete, canceled and superseded requests.
Foreground sync and an explicitly enabled owned runner reconcile latest approved revisions with bounded work and report catch-up independently of host loading.

Disposable enrolled macOS and native Windows devices demonstrate a real SSH rollout, update and offline catch-up. Native scheduler evidence and any missing authority or environment gates remain explicit.
milestones.boundary: Stage D rollout of skills. No production enrollment, program or operating system updates, live repository publication, credentials or access changes.
